game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace, a seaside tavern terrace: the fisher must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of smugglers, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace: a seaside tavern terrace
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Terrace, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of smugglers, dodge the other. Each round, a new sea charts challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the hero_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of sea charts by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Tavern Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how hero_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Tavern Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 59 seconds.
